assumptions.text: D-02, D-03: All three lifetimes accept nil/zero unlimited and positive issuance snapshots, with deterministic before/equality/after checks using existing injected clocks.
D-02, D-04: Equality is expired independently for each lifetime; an earlier expired credential cannot mask the app gate, valid expired-app GET/DELETE, forbidden PUT, or disabled-state denial.
D-02: Empty/null policy means unlimited, no-secret authentication makes the secret gate inapplicable, and no arbitrary ordering policy is inferred for absent fields.

D-02, D-04: Equal deadlines use the fixed endpoint gate precedence; GET/authentication/enablement do not renew, secret replacement preserves app/management deadlines, and management replacement/recovery preserves app/secret deadlines.
D-04: Rejected code redemption preserves its code/grant; stored expiry, access JWT exp and expires_in agree while independent assertion timing/replay and online/offline limits remain visible.
